release.note: L118 is fixed as I asked: lean/TVA/Lang/Scalar.lean:103 now gives I8 its own docstring ('`tl.int8` values.') and :106 gives I32 the int32 one ('the type of tl.program_id, tl.arange and most index arithmetic'); the bodies are unchanged (work/Names5.lean prints TVA.I32 = TVA.IntV Bool.true 32 and TVA.I8 = TVA.IntV Bool.true 8), and the model uses I32. The two pages L118 also names now say what point 7 says: the rule page's 'What it says' and TVA.Claim's module docstring give CPython 3.13 without -O or -OO and with PYTHONOPTIMIZE unset.

L117 is fixed, by the user's decision under L36, in every copy of point 11 (the docstring of Rules.Compiler.Faithful, docs/rules/compiler-faithful.md Scope 11 and What it does not cover, docs/SEMANTICS.md Parameters and arguments, A launch's compiled kernel and Launches, docs/exclusions.md, TVA.Claim): the code the launch runs is the code Triton compiles for that launch from its own argument values, compile-time and runtime, as the instance gives them, and the reuse clause is gone; cached code counts only when it is that code, 'for example' a repeated launch. So neither reading of F3 remains: code compiled for another specialisation of a runtime argument is no longer admitted, and a later launch at another size (the benchmark's 2^13 ... 2^27 after 2^12) is covered by the assumption, not shut out by the example. The runtime value n is part of the instance and Inst.ok constrains it (n < 2^31, n <= x.len, y.len, output.len), as the decision asks; the README's Conditions and Modelling decisions now say so.
